STRUCT_HARDENED.pretty: no hit from sequence or structure

rise_explained: the 18 proteins removed by structural hardening score 0.559, below the 70-protein set's 0.625, so removing them raises the mean. A remote structural relative does not make a protein easier to annotate by embedding transfer; fold-level similarity is often functionally uninformative.
warning: Fmax ROSE from 0.625 (no hit, either sequence search, n=70) to 0.649 (no hit from sequence or structure, n=52). Removing proteins that have detectable relatives should leave a HARDER set, so a rise needs explaining before it is reported.
note: Scored through 36_bootstrap_baseline.py's own register_subset and predictions path, so these are comparable with every other figure in the paper.
